text_block_list.text:
It's hella nutritious! I'll hook you up with
some
too, Spe!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Thanks, El! I've never had cactus before!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey Trainer! Do you want some
cactus too?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
My mama and papa sent me some to
keep me
healthy!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I couldn't believe it when El told me you
can eat
cactus!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
All kinds of ways! You can make it into
steak, or
hamburgers, even smoothies!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Wow! There's that many ways?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
My papa taught me! Cactus is one of his

specialties!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm givin' you some too, Trainer! How do
you want
it?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: I'd love to try a smoothie!

text_block_list.text: Steak is my go-to!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It's hella filling, and it's great for diets
too!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: It's filling and good for diets?! Incredible! It sounds magical!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! You sure are curious about this,
aren't
ya, Spe?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
You can get hella strong and actually
enjoy
dieting if you're eatin' cactus
steak!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Let's go to the dorm kitchen and get
cooking!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I enjoy the cactus steak that El Condor
Pasa
prepared. However...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Urgh... I ate too much... I can't move...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm so full... but I'm also so
happy!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Great idea! Cactus is also great for
calming you
down!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I see! If that's true, then...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Can I become as calm as Suzuka?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Maybe!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Maybe the reason I'm so calm and
collected is
because I drink so much
cactus!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I let the comment about her being "calm
and
collected" slide so I can get a
smoothie as soon as
possible.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса makes the cactus
smoothies and
we take them to the
cafeteria, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ouch! I forgot to take out the spikes!
Ugh, my
cheek hella hurts!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Ah! So that's what that was! Are you
okay, El?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
What?! Did you eat them, Spe?! Are you
a
camel?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
We learn that no matter how good
something
may be for a diet, it's
pointless if you eat too
much.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I take care to avoid the cactus spikes
and end up
enjoying the smoothie quite
a bit.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
